labels.value: Type a stack of checks into a grid, set the date, fund and appeal once at the top, and post the batch when what you have typed matches the deposit slip.

labels.value: The total from your deposit slip or adding machine tape. The batch will not post until what you have typed adds up to this.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the batch posted
Gift batch entry: how many gifts the batch produced
labels.value: This batch posted {0} gifts. They are ordinary gifts now: they show on donor records, count in your totals, and can be receipted.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: opening a batch that has posted
Gift batch entry: something went wrong
Gift batch entry: a line names both kinds of donor
labels.value: This line names a person and an organization. A gift has exactly one donor.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: a line has no donor
labels.value: This line has no donor. Find the person or organization that gave.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: a line has no usable amount
labels.value: This line needs an amount greater than zero.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: a line has no date
labels.value: This line needs a gift date.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: a line has no payment method
labels.value: This line needs a payment method. Set one at the top of the batch to fill in every line.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the batch balances but some lines are unfinished
labels.value: This batch balances, but some lines are not finished. Fix the lines marked below and post again.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the batch is gone
labels.value: That batch could not be found. It may have been deleted by someone else.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the batch has already posted
labels.value: This batch has already been posted, so it cannot be posted again. Its gifts were created the first time.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the batch has no lines
labels.value: This batch has no lines yet, so there is nothing to post.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the batch has no control total
labels.value: Enter the deposit slip total before posting, so there is something to check against.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the lines total less than the deposit slip
labels.value: This batch does not balance. What you have typed is {0} short of the deposit slip total. Find the missing gift, or correct the deposit slip total, then post again.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the lines total more than the deposit slip
labels.value: This batch does not balance. What you have typed is {0} more than the deposit slip total. Look for a line entered twice or an amount typed wrong, then post again.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the post failed part way
labels.value: This batch did not post, and nothing was created: the whole batch is still here as you left it.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: somebody tried to change a posted batch
labels.value: This batch has been posted, so it cannot be changed. To correct a gift it created, refund or write off that gift.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: somebody tried to delete a posted batch
labels.value: This batch has been posted, so it cannot be deleted. It is the record of what was deposited.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: somebody set the status to Posted by hand
labels.value: A batch is posted by opening it and choosing Post batch, which is what creates the gifts. Setting the status by hand would close the batch without creating anything.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: somebody tried to change a line of a posted batch
labels.value: This batch has been posted, so its lines cannot be changed. They are the record of what was on the deposit slip.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: somebody tried to add a line to a posted batch
labels.value: This batch has been posted, so no more lines can be added to it. Start a new batch for gifts that arrived since.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: somebody tried to delete a line of a posted batch
labels.value: This batch has been posted, so its lines cannot be deleted.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the screen could not read the org defaults
labels.value: The batch could not be set up. Ask your administrator to check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the list of open batches could not be read
labels.value: Your open batches could not be listed. Ask your administrator to check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: one batch could not be read
labels.value: This batch could not be opened. Ask your administrator to check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the header could not be saved
labels.value: The batch could not be saved. Nothing was lost: try again in a moment.

labels.shortDescription: Gift batch entry: the lines could not be saved
labels.value: Your lines could not be saved. Nothing was lost from the screen: try again in a moment.
